title: Native happiness association ranking with unsteered teacher-forced contexts
status: Freeze before any 103 capture; root alone runs sole GPU process
context_provenance: Manually authored fixed paired contexts by independent audit agent, before any activation capture or generated happy-output scoring. All topics disjoint across discovery/confirmation. Corpus contains the complete source text.
capture: Mean native silu(gate_proj(x))*up_proj(x), before down_proj, across identical label-free assistant suffix token IDs only; no interventions; independent cache=None forward per narrative; full original 32x9216 axes. Teacher-forced narrative supplies affect context.
token_label_control: Same neutral system and matched topic prompt across each five-way contrast; no labels supplied in system/user instruction; identical shared scored suffix without emotion/persona label words; suffix token IDs explicitly concatenated and logged. This does not eliminate narrative lexical/style/length differences or synthetic-text selection bias.

ranking.sign: Per-axis sign of discovery mean joy-minus-neutral only; zero gets +1
ranking.consistency: Fraction of discovery contexts with sign*(joy-control)>0
ranking.score: Minimum standardized effect across all four controls, multiplied by cube of minimum consistency across controls. Negative values retained.
ranking.ordering: Descending discovery score; stable original flattened axis order breaks ties. No confirmation-based reranking, candidate replacement or coefficient fitting.
ranking.all_axes: Retain raw captures, all per-contrast statistics, per-contrast discovery order permutations, full discovery order, compressed all-axis rows; compact top64 CSV.
ranking.confirmation: Report fixed-sign mean/effect/consistency separately at same axes, never feeds discovery ranking.
ranking.atlas_leads: L13N4810, L24N7361, L28N1478, L25N7455, L22N8753 logged descriptively at same frozen axes; their expected published signs never alter ranking.

published_norms.role: Verify provenance for later native dose screens; raw natural activations remain unnormalized. No dose or intervention selected by this script.

prohibited: autonomous GPU launch by delegated agent
limitations: Association with synthetic teacher-forced positive text is not proof of happiness, emotion, natural neuron function or causal control. Confounds can survive fixed-token capture. Six discovery topics, four confirmation topics and 294912 comparisons imply unstable ranks and selection bias. Independent single-coordinate causal screens and neutral task tests remain required.
